WELCOMEDOOR

👻 GHOST — 8 Humans vs 2 Demons ⚔️
🏠 The night has fallen... and 2 Demons are hunting. 8 Humans must barricade up, build their economy, and SURVIVE 20 minutes! 🕛
💰 Stack your cash machines and gear factories to print money! 💵⚙️

🚪 Upgrade your doors from flimsy wood to ETERNAL DIVINE GATES! 🛡️

🔫 Unlock 6 legendary weapons — ending with the HORN OF COUNTERATTACK, powerful enough to slay even the final-form Demon! 😈💥

🔥 Build turrets, defend your base, and turn the tide!
😱 But beware... the Demons EVOLVE. The longer the match drags on, the stronger they grow — until they become unstoppable nightmares! 🌑
⏳ Can the Humans outlast the hunt? Or will the Demons feast tonight? 🩸
👉 Grab your friends, pick a side, and find out who survives! 🎮
